name: Ball Simulator [😡 UPD]
desc:
🎯 Balls are falling from the sky — grab them fast!
Collect colorful balls raining down around you and sell them for money. Race others and rise to the top of the leaderboard!

💸 Upgrade and unlock new zones
Use your money to buy powerful upgrades and explore new areas to collect even cooler balls!

🌟 Rare balls & special events
Some balls spawn with rare mutations or appear during events — they're worth way more, so be ready!

🔁 Weekly updates
More content, features, and surprises coming all the time!

Credits: 
Lead Developers - @PalashRBX & @MyroDev 
Contributors - @Leopold_Slime & @TheEnchantedMiner682

Inspired by Stud Simulator
